opening.argument: The program is presented as a live-TV interview and focuses on government questions, elections, and political developments across several regions. Its discussion of the PNB Bank matter and alleged media suppression remains part of that political commentary: the speaker says, “4000 crore is suppressed. So, scams are happening. To suppress them, the state is using the Dogi and Dalal Media,” without asking viewers to invest, pay, provide credentials, or join a money-making scheme. The broadcast framing and identified subject matter therefore support a reporting and commentary context, while the record does not establish the allegation independently or show a financial solicitation.
